content: No established open-source deterministic-simulation-testing framework exists for Go (search 2026-10-31: articles and commercial Antithesis only; TigerBeetle VOPR and marionette are Zig). Standard Go approach is in-repo mostly-DST per Polar Signals blog (2024-05-28): abstract time and network behind interfaces, seeded chaos virtual network, assert convergence invariants; Go 1.25+ testing/synctest provides stable virtual-time bubbles. FoundationDB-style bit-identical traces are not achievable in plain Go.
